svg.title: HF Factory v1 architecture: REST control plane, Data Engine s3-s7, API Engine s8, ports and adapters
svg.text: Healthcare AI Platform Factory · Data Engine + API Engine (v1)
Each stage runs from its own job payload · scenarios S1–S4 · deterministic synthetic data · one variable switches local and GCP
Registry: one run per tenant (tenant from consumes.alloydb) · payload checks → 409 / 422 · stage order enforced
payload-driven · per-row seeded · UUIDv5 ids · idempotent re-runs
s3 fixes seed · as_of_date · catalog 2.4.0 · tenant · later payloads add volumes, lob_mix, scenario_mix, entities
shards: local tasks or Cloud Run Job tasks
use_cases switch endpoints on · OpenAPI 3.1 + tools.json
OAuth2 client credentials · rate limit · fault injection
engines call only these interfaces · + Executor port (local / Cloud Run Jobs)

g.text: • in-memory DuckDB, dicts, NumPy index, logs
• memory: real Vertex AI for text + embeddings
• data regenerates identically after a restart
Cloud Run Jobs · Cloud Run · API Gateway
names from the s2 output JSON

svg.text: implemented · not yet run on GCP
Stage order: s3 → s4 → s5 → s6 → s7 → s8 (v1 runs s6 after s5: care records and denial links need claims). Every row is synthetic and stamped with tenant_id and scenario_id.
Repo: hf-factory · src/factory/control (REST) · data_engine (s3–s7) · api_engine (s8) · adapters (ports) · config/*.yaml (profiles)
